::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-buggy"}
The Buggy is a scrap-plated car with a machine gun, and Grubstake's scout. One circling your base just outside turret range is looking for something unguarded, and the next raid goes where it went. Where a buggy is killed, the next one keeps further away. Its machine gun slows the infantry it hits.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-shotgun-hand"}
The Shotgunner is Grubstake's basic soldier: heavy armor, a pump shotgun and a set of wrenches. Shotgunners do the looting. They walk up to machines no turret covers, take them apart and carry them home, and fight only at close range. A gun turret at each outpost keeps them off.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-harrier"}
The Scrap copter is a small helicopter built from salvage, with a light gun. Alone it is weak; Grubstake sends them in swarms over walls, cliffs and water, at lone poles and machines. Gun turrets shoot them down. Flamethrower turrets cannot. A copter shot down crashes a few tiles away and damages what it lands on.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-slug"}
The Slug buggy trades the buggy's machine gun for a heavy slug gun and adds armor at the front. Its slug pierces a tank's armor, but it fires slowly and does poorly against infantry. Send troopers at it and keep your tanks away.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-sapper"}
The Dynamite sapper throws sticks of dynamite from beyond shotgun range. The blast covers a few tiles and does not hurt Grubstake's own units, so sappers fight right among the Shotgunners. Keep your squads spread out.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-scavenger"}
The Bomb drone is a small quadcopter with a bomb slung under it. It flies straight at one target, usually an artillery turret, a mortar or a radar, and blows up when it gets there. Shot down, it falls and its bomb goes off where it lands. A gun turret set out in front of each artillery turret stops it short; a flak turret stops it sooner.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-dozer"}
The Dozer is a bulldozer with an armored cab. Sent at a wall, it stops short, revs its engine and charges straight through, crushing walls, gates and buildings in its lane, and the buggies follow it in. Rocket troopers and battle tanks stop it. Its charge ends some way past the wall, so a second wall set further back is still standing when it stops.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-flak-buggy"}
The Flak buggy is a buggy with a turret that fires scrap flak. The bursts shred drones and combat robots but barely hurt anything on the ground. Keep your combat robots back and send ground units.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-scorcher"}
The Flame tank is an old tank hull with a flamethrower and a machine gun. The machine gun does most of the fighting and slows the infantry it hits. Every few seconds the flamethrower burns a group of units in front of it. Fire does not harm it, but it is lightly armored for a tank and has to get close. When it is destroyed, its fuel explodes and burns around the wreck. Hit it with rockets and artillery on the way in.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-howitzer-truck"}
The Howitzer truck carries a howitzer on a hauler's chassis, and only a camp that landed with a grudge has one. It comes out against walls that robots keep mending, to shell the roboports behind them. Your artillery outranges it and engages it on its own.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-hauler"}
The Hauler does Grubstake's heavy work: it builds new lots, carries loot home, hauls ore from the claims and parks beside your belts to skim them. A destroyed hauler drops its load. Cut the road between a claim and its camp: a claim with no ore coming home lapses, and its drills are yours to take.
:::
